name: StudyLens AI
tagline: Understand documents, verify drafts, and study smarter
description: StudyLens AI is a focused study workspace for students and professionals. Its AI-native workflow first analyzes a pasted or uploaded document into structured evidence, then generates a grounded learning kit: summaries, key concepts, action items, flashcards, quizzes, and follow-up answers. A separate verification pass checks generated content against the source, reports missing or unsupported claims, and shows the passages behind each result. Quiz generation includes concept coverage and grading identifies weak areas to review. Ask questions in a document-specific chat; when the answer is absent, StudyLens says “Not found in your document” instead of guessing. Long documents are processed in bounded chunks, Unicode text is handled safely, and malformed model responses are retried with a deterministic rule-based fallback when sampling is unavailable. Every generated block is labelled AI-generated or Basic mode. To use it, paste notes, an article, transcript, or report, review the extracted text, and select Analyze. Explore summary modes, source-linked concepts, study actions, flashcards, quiz practice, and grounded Q&A from the Results tabs. Analyses are saved to History so you can reopen, search, rename, delete, or export them as Markdown or plain text.
